title: EASY-style backfill over the priority queue

logs.msg: Implemented admit_backfill (EASY): blocked heads get shadow times from lease-expiry event projections; later requests admitted only when they finish before shadow or claim disjoint nodes; dead heads block nobody; fair-share ceilings apply in the walk. BackfillCtx groups now/leases/open_bindings. 6 scenarios in crates/sim/tests/backfill.rs; 51 tests pass, clippy clean. Committed 58a1198 and pushed.
